Tonight, we showed that you can stand up to billionaires in the heart of Silicon Valley and prevail. When I supported a billionaire tax, the tech lords recruited a candidate to primary me and spent $1 million on false attacks. They predicted an “end” to my career. The results speak for themselves. The progressive movement can win anywhere! 

I want to congratulate Republicans Ritesh Tandon and Jennie Ha Phan- one of them will be in the top 2. I also want to congratulate @ethanagarwal for running
Proud to have been an early endorser of my former colleague @DebHaalandNM. Congratulations to you. You will make a phenomenal Governor and NM is a model on childcare and free college for the nation.

Congratulations to @HamawyForNJ for your big win in the primary. The progressive movement is on the march. You stood up with courage to call out genocide and foreign wars and to stand for Medicare for All. I was proud to support you.

Congratulations to @turek4iowa on your big win! Proud to know you and be an early endorser. I am confident you will follow Harkin's footsteps and be a progressive populist who will represent Iowa in the Senate!

.@katz_morris is one of the most brilliant political strategists of his generation. You know why young folks are turned off by politics. They hate that the establishment plants dirt on folks like Morris just b/c his candidates speak out on genocide or taxing billionaires.

The current political class is so out of touch with where the energy and passion of our party is. I cant wait until Morris's generation leads and it's happening in 26 and 28!

Appointing Pulte, who has criminally targeted Trump's opponents and has zero experience, to be Director of National Intelligence, shows we have a mafia government.

The naked corruption is crazy and frightening.

We need to define a public mission for the use of AI for the people -- solving rare disease or improving electric batteries --instead of just new chatbots or addictive algorithms. Today is Election Day.

Thousands of voters across the district are heading to the polls today. Once again, I’m asking you to trust me with your vote. 

Polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.

Find your polling place here: sos.ca.gov/elections/polling…

As we begin Pride Month, we celebrate the LGBTQ+ community and the leaders who continue to move our country forward.

I’m grateful for organizations like LGBTQ+ Victory Fund that help recruit, train, support, and elect LGBTQ+ leaders at every level of government. Thank you to the staff, board, supporters, and candidates who make this work possible. @Evan_Low
Happy Pride Month to the LGBTQ+ community. Decades of progress are being attacked across our government, and we must defend their rights at every turn.

Thomas Massie and I are not done working together. Section 224 of our defense bill means to integrate our military with Israel's military. 

As a senior member of the Armed Services committee, I am introducing an amendment to stop financing and enabling war crimes.
